tool_schemas.name: web_search_exa
tool_schemas.description: Runs an Exa-powered web search for the provided query and returns a page of results up to limit; when more results are available, the response includes an opaque cursor that can be supplied to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty, limit is not a positive integer, or cursor is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller lacks valid API credentials and FORBIDDEN if the credential is not permitted to use web search. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace or key has exhausted its allotted search capacity and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected upstream failures.

query.description: Search query to run against the web.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: websets_manager
tool_schemas.description: Performs one websets operation per call (action) within the specified workspace: create a webset, ingest items, search within a webset (paged with limit and cursor), run AI enhancements over selected items, or set up/check notifications, returning the created/updated resource or the requested page/status for the action. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields for the chosen action are missing or malformed (including workspace_id/webset_id patterns, invalid enums, and missing body sections such as webset/items/search/enhancement/notification), and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the workspace or perform the requested action. Raises NOT_FOUND when workspace_id does not exist or is not accessible, or when webset_id/item_ids referenced by the action do not exist in that workspace; raises CONFLICT when the request attempts an invalid state transition (for example operating on archived/deleted websets or enhancing/ingesting removed items) or would create a duplicate/ambiguous record for a canonical URL in the same webset, and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when storage, ingestion, enhancement, or notification limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that owns the operation.

webset_id.description: Webset ID to operate on (required for actions that target an existing webset).

body.description: Action-specific request body for creating websets, ingesting items, searching, enhancing, or configuring notifications.

webset.description: Fields used when creating a webset.

description.description: Optional description of what the webset contains.

source_config.description: Source configuration metadata for how the webset is populated (stored as JSON).

items.description: Items to add/record into a webset.

content_text.description: Full extracted text content of the document.

exa_result_id.description: Optional Exa result identifier when item originated from Exa search.

published_at.description: Optional published timestamp for the document.

search.description: Parameters for searching within a webset.

query.description: Search query to run over items in the webset.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

enhancement.description: Parameters for running AI enhancements on webset items.

item_ids.description: Specific webset item IDs to enhance.

query.description: Optional query to select items to enhance (enhance items matching a search).

notification.description: Parameters for setting up or checking notifications for a webset.

query.description: Query used to detect new matching content for the webset.

tool_schemas.name: websets_guide
tool_schemas.description: Returns vendor-authored guidance for the requested topic, including recommended workflows and examples for creating websets, ingesting items, searching, enhancing, and notifications. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if topic is missing or not one of the supported values. Raises INTERNAL_ERROR only if the guide content cannot be retrieved.

tool_schemas.name: auth_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, the resolved workspace attribution, granted scopes, and current month quota consumption/remaining for the workspace. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid or REVOKED, and FORBIDDEN if the key is not entitled to this workspace.

api_key.description: Secret API key presented by the caller (e.g., via Authorization header); when provided here it overrides server-default credentials.

tool_schemas.name: workspaces_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists workspaces visible to the authenticated API key, optionally filtered by status, returning a paged result set. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to list workspaces.

api_key.description: Secret API key presented by the caller (optional override).

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: workspaces_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable workspace fields and/or performs a lifecycle status transition. Only allows declared transitions (active↔suspended, active/suspended→deleted). Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or payloads, FORBIDDEN for insufficient privileges, and records no mutation when rejected.

api_key.description: Secret API key presented by the caller (optional override).

monthly_search_limit.description: Monthly Exa web search cost-unit limit for the workspace.

monthly_enhancement_limit.description: Monthly enhancement cost-unit limit for the workspace.

status.description: Workspace lifecycle status (must follow allowed transitions).

tool_schemas.name: api_keys_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key within the specified workspace and returns the key material once along with the persisted API key record. Refuses FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot manage keys for the workspace or if the workspace is not active.

api_key.description: Secret API key presented by the caller (optional override).

workspace_id.description: Workspace that will own the API key.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the API key.

tool_schemas.name: api_keys_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists API keys for a workspace (never returns secret key material), optionally filtered by status, returning a paged result set. Refuses FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view keys for the workspace.

api_key.description: Secret API key presented by the caller (optional override).

workspace_id.description: Workspace to list API keys for.

limit.description: Maximum number of API keys to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: operations_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single operation by id, including its stored request/result/error payloads and lifecycle status. Refuses FORBIDDEN if the operation is not in the caller's attributed workspace.

api_key.description: Secret API key presented by the caller (optional override).

metadata.name: Exa Websets Server
